lessons.goal: 依完成期限與裝置需求協調借用。

questions.evidence: Club chat: We have one tablet for today's work. The photography group needs it to select pictures before their meeting at four. The science group wants to record a short presentation at four thirty. Neither group needs to take the tablet home.
questions.explanation: 選照片須在四點會議前完成。
questions.prompt: Which group needs to finish its task before four?

questions.evidence: Alina: We will return it to the office at three fifty. Omar: Good. I can collect it at four twenty, set it up, and record from four thirty. Please leave the charger with the tablet even if the battery still looks full.
questions.explanation: Omar 明說 4:20 領取，先做準備。
questions.prompt: When does Omar plan to collect the tablet?

questions.evidence: Teacher: Put your files in your own group's folder before returning the device. Do not delete the other group's work to make the screen look tidy. If storage is low, tell me first so we can save the files safely.
questions.explanation: 個別資料夾便於管理且不需刪別組資料。
options: To keep work organized without deleting another group's files.
To make the recording take longer.
questions.prompt: Why should each group use its own folder?

questions.evidence: Alina: Our photo selection will take twenty minutes. We can start at three thirty. Omar: Our recording takes fifteen minutes, but we need ten minutes beforehand to set the tablet on a stand and check the sound.
questions.explanation: 錄影前有十分鐘架設及音效確認。

questions.prompt: How much time passes between the planned return and Omar's pickup?
